title: Cory Totem
description: You now can have Cory (spazkid) as a totem of undying!
body:
Ever wanted to have your own Cory (Spazkid) Plush as a totem? Well now you do!

He will be by your side until they end of time! He is your guardian angel, protecting you from any harm. Make sure to take good care of cory like feeding him Sonic fanart in the meantime.
